translations.web: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son, who sees all his father’s sins, which he has done, and fears, and does not such like;
translations.bsb: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:
translations.kjv: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
translations.asv: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins, which he hath done, and feareth, and doeth not such like;
